patthana22.26:1.1: na sanidassanasappaṭighaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. na anidassanasappaṭighaṃ na hetuṃ dhammaṃ paṭicca anidassanaappaṭigho hetu dhammo uppajjati hetupaccayā:. hetuyā tīṇi.
